lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements all requirements defined in PMAT-3273. It enforces deterministic transcendentals using `libm` with a strict `disallowed_methods` clippy rule, replaces standard math library calls (such as `powi` and `exp`) across the codebase, introduces `COORD_GRID` quantisation, and writes glyph outlines instead of relying on local fonts. It also adds the two-architecture determinism verification workflows that distinguishes SVG identity (asserted) from PNG identity (recorded only), exactly as requested. There are no deviations from the ticket or weakened tests/gates.

PMAT-3273 (APEX-2a) implementation is fully verified and adheres strictly to all ticket requirements and acceptance criteria without refutation. The ticket title was updated in commit e89de5199 to unpromise cross-architecture PNG identity (svg_identical is ASSERTED from SVG bytes; PNG identity is RECORDED as png_identical and never asserted, matching APEX-001 v4.7 and determinism-compare.sh). All 12 clippy disallowed-methods libm bans are proven live by libm-ban-live.sh, determinism-compare.sh passes all self-test cases and refutes the mutant, all 10 tests in render_determinism.rs pass, and CI gates properly require determinism-compare without weakening existing checks.

findings.claim: Cross-architecture comparison script determinism-compare.sh asserts svg_identical from SVG sha256 bytes (.svg_identical == true) and records png_identical without asserting it (# Recorded, deliberately NOT asserted: this verdict decides EV-15's manifest shape), adhering strictly to the updated ticket PMAT-3273 requirement.

Running `bash scripts/ci/determinism-compare.sh --self-test` passes all 6 case table entries (including differing PNG, differing SVG, single host, single architecture, and old shape) and successfully refutes the mutant deciding svg_identical from manifest_root.

Clippy disallowed-methods ban is live and enforces pure-Rust libm across all 12 transcendental methods (f32/f64: ln, log10, log2, exp, powf, powi), verified via `bash scripts/ci/libm-ban-live.sh` which confirms 12 diagnostics on planted probe and clean pass on restore.

All 10 tests in render_determinism.rs pass via `cargo test -p aprender-viz --features text-path,raster --test render_determinism`, verifying same-host PNG and SVG byte identity, libm exactness, coordinate grid snapping, breaks extended ticks, and receipt generation.
The CI workflow defines clean-room X64 and ARM64 matrix runners for determinism and wires determinism-compare into gate.needs and required check validation without weakening any existing gates.
COORD_GRID = 1e-3 snapping along with quantise, quantise_path_data, and format_coord ensures that all emitted SVG coordinates are quantised to the coordinate grid and -0.0 is normalized to 0.0.

lanes.summary:
Independent review of PMAT-3273 diff (origin/main...HEAD): PASS.

The diff implements APEX-2a deterministic render primitive strictly according to the ticket requirements and acceptance criteria without weakening any gates or introducing unrequested changes:

1. Deterministic Math & Clippy Ban (EV-2a rule 5):
   - `crates/aprender-viz/.clippy.toml` configures 12 disallowed method entries (f32 and f64 variants of ln, log10, log2, exp, powf, powi).
   - `crates/aprender-viz/src/lib.rs` activates `#![deny(clippy::disallowed_methods)]`.
   - `scripts/ci/libm-ban-live.sh` verified live: planting probes triggers 12 distinct diagnostics and fails with error; clean tree passes.
   - All call sites in `scale.rs`, `breaks.rs`, `plots/{boxplot,force_graph,histogram}.rs`, and examples replaced platform math with `libm` equivalents or direct multiplication (`sq(x) = x * x`).

2. Coordinate Quantisation (EV-2a rule 5):
   - `COORD_GRID = 1e-3` defined in `src/lib.rs` with `quantise`, `quantise_path_data`, and `format_coord`.
   - All SVG element formatting in `src/output/svg.rs` routes numeric coordinates through `format_coord` / `quantise_path_data`.

3. Text Outlines & Pinned PNG Encoding:
   - `src/text.rs` provides `to_path`, `to_path_data`, and `to_path_data_at` using caller-pinned font bytes via `skrifa` and `kurbo` under `text-path` feature.
   - `src/output/png_encoder.rs` pins `Compression::Fast`, `FilterType::NoFilter`, and `NonAdaptive` with no timestamp or text metadata chunks.

4. Manifest Verification:
   - `src/manifest.rs` implements flat SHA-256 tree hashing over raw bytes with refusal-on-mismatch semantics (`Error::ManifestMismatch`).

5. CI Workflow & Determinism Compare:
   - `.github/workflows/ci.yml` introduces matrix job `determinism` across clean-room X64 and ARM64 runners and `determinism-compare` job, wired into `gate.needs`.
   - `scripts/ci/determinism-compare.sh` asserts `svg_identical` from SVG digests, records `png_identical`, and passes `--self-test` (including detecting the `manifest_root` mutant).

6. Verification Suite & Sanity Checks:
   - `tests/render_determinism.rs` executes 10 tests verifying same-host PNG/SVG repeatability, grid quantisation, log-scale bit accuracy against `libm`, EV-2b breaks tick placement, and receipt generation.
   - All `aprender-viz` tests (unit, integration, benchmarks) and clippy pass cleanly.
   - Roadmap uniqueness, sorting, and tree-reader checks pass.
